title: Cloud Digital Leader & Business Foundations — Scope & Architecture Map
purpose: Maps Google Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) governance: connects Executive Sponsors, Center of Excellence (CoE), FinOps Cost Centers, and cloud migration workstreams.
routing_rationale: Cloud transformation requires foundational alignment between People, Process, and Technology. Value streams and budget governance precede multi-workload migration.

groups.label: Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) & Landing Zone

nodes.label: Executive Sponsor
nodes.detail: Establishes cloud vision, business value metrics, and CapEx to OpEx funding model.

nodes.label: FinOps Cost Governance
nodes.detail: Tracks unit economics, budget allocation, and committed use discounts.

nodes.label: Cloud Center of Excellence
nodes.detail: Defines guardrails, Terraform landing zones, and shared VPC blueprints.

nodes.label: Enterprise Landing Zone
nodes.detail: Provisioned baseline infrastructure: Org policies, central logging, and peering.

nodes.label: Business Unit Fleet
nodes.detail: Modernized application workloads operating within enterprise compliance perimeters.

steps.title: Strategic Charter
steps.action: Executive sponsors establish CCoE charter and digital transformation roadmap.
steps.why_traversal: Executive alignment prevents shadow IT and establishes unified governance.

steps.title: FinOps Foundation
steps.action: FinOps team associates centralized billing accounts and budget alerts to projects.
steps.why_traversal: Ensures cost visibility and prevents unallocated infrastructure expenditure.

steps.title: Landing Zone Provisioning
steps.action: CCoE deploys automated Terraform landing zone with organization security constraints.
steps.why_traversal: Provides secure, compliant foundation before migrating production workloads.

steps.title: Squad Onboarding
steps.action: Business unit engineering squads receive pre-configured project environments.
steps.why_traversal: Accelerates time-to-market while guaranteeing security compliance.

scenarios.label: Unsanctioned Cloud Adoption
scenarios.root_cause: Product team bypassed CCoE landing zone and created unmanaged projects.
scenarios.diverted_path: Unmanaged projects lack central logging and organization policy constraints.
scenarios.blast_radius: Security perimeter vulnerabilities and unmonitored cloud spending.
scenarios.recovery: Enforce organization creation restrictions; migrate unmanaged projects into CCoE hierarchy.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Maps Google Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) governance: connects Executive Sponsors, Center of Excellence (CoE), FinOps Cost Centers, and cloud migration workstreams.
